functions.name: RumbleBoard_Tower_Dtor
functions.parameters: param_1: RumbleBoard* this — the Tower Arena board object to destroy
functions.description: Destructor for Tower Arena board. Sets vtable to PTR_RumbleBoard_OddArena_DeletingDtor, frees 2 sub-mesh objects at +0x11F8 and +0x12FF via vtable delete, then calls Scene_dtor for base cleanup.

functions.name: RumbleBoard_UpArena_Ctor
functions.parameters: this: RumbleBoard* — arena board to construct | param_1: int — parent App/Scene pointer
functions.description: Constructor for Up Arena. Calls RumbleBoard_ctor, sets vtable, names 'RumbleBoard (Up Arena)' / 'UP ARENA'. Creates MeshWorld 'levels\\arena-up' and CollisionLevel. Initializes Vec3 (1,0,1).

functions.name: RumbleBoard_UpArena_Dtor
functions.parameters: param_1: RumbleBoard* this — the Up Arena board to destroy
functions.description: Destructor for Up Arena board. Sets vtable, frees sub-mesh at +0x11F8 via vtable delete, then calls RumbleBoard_dtor for base cleanup.

functions.name: Scene_ComputeArenaLighting
functions.parameters: this: Scene* | param_1: float* — output lighting/color buffer | param_2: int — ball/player index for per-player lighting
functions.description: Computes per-ball arena lighting. Iterates collision face lists, accumulates light contributions from nearby objects. Returns modified param_1 (lighting buffer). Complex 5099-char function with nested loops over AthenaLists.
functions.struct_offsets: Multiple collision mesh offsets, AthenaList iteration

functions.name: RumbleBoard_ExpertArena_ctor
functions.parameters: this: RumbleBoard* | param_1: int — parent App/Scene
functions.description: Constructor for Expert Arena. Calls RumbleBoard_ctor, sets vtable, names 'RumbleBoard (Expert Arena)' / 'Fight!'. Initializes AthenaList at +0x47E0. Vec3 init.

functions.name: RumbleBoard_OddArena_ctor
functions.parameters: this: RumbleBoard* | param_1: int — parent App/Scene
functions.description: Constructor for Odd Arena. Calls RumbleBoard_ctor, sets vtable, names 'RumbleBoard (Odd Arena)' / 'ODD ARENA'. Clears flag at +0x4348. Vec3 init (1,0.5,0).

functions.name: RumbleBoard_ToobArena_ctor
functions.parameters: this: RumbleBoard* | param_1: int — parent App/Scene
functions.description: Constructor for Toob Arena. Calls RumbleBoard_ctor, sets vtable, names 'RumbleBoard (Toob Arena)' / 'Rodenthood'. Initializes 5-element array at +0x47E0 (0x418 bytes each) via _eh_vector_constructor_iterator.

functions.name: Scene_ApplyGravityDrag
functions.parameters: param_1: Scene* this — the scene to apply gravity drag to
functions.description: Applies gravity drag decay to 4+ reflection values at +0x5C58/+0x5C5C/+0x5C60/+0x5C64 by subtracting _DAT_004CF428 and clamping to minimum _DAT_004CF6A8. Called as vtable HandleRaceEnd variant — reduces mirror effects after race ends.

functions.name: RumbleBoard_WobblyArena_ctor
functions.parameters: this: RumbleBoard* | param_1: int — parent App/Scene
functions.description: Constructor for Wobbly Arena. Calls RumbleBoard_ctor, sets vtable, names 'RumbleBoard (Wobbly Arena)' / 'Hamster Chase' / 'WOBBLY ARENA'. Creates MeshWorld 'levels\\arena-wobbly'. Vec3 init.

functions.name: RumbleBoard_WobblyArena_DeletingDtor
functions.parameters: param_1: RumbleBoard* this — the Wobbly Arena board to destroy
functions.description: Scalar deleting destructor for Wobbly Arena board. Sets vtable, frees sub-mesh at +0x11F8 via vtable delete, then calls RumbleBoard_dtor for base cleanup.
